item.title: Ebola Outbreak and Merck Vaccine Ervebo
item.description:
• Summary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Experts are weighing the use of Merck's Ervebo vaccine to control the spread. The CDC has announced travel bans, and suspected cases have been reported in the U.S.
  • MoAs: Ervebo is a live-attenuated vesicular stomatitis virus vector vaccine expressing the Ebola virus glycoprotein. It induces an immune response against Ebola virus.
  • Sources: STAT, STAT, Pharmaceutical Technology, STAT, STAT

item.title: Hantavirus Outbreak on Cruise Ship
item.description:
• Summary: An outbreak of hantavirus on a cruise ship is reported, drawing comparisons to COVID-19 flashbacks and fueling conspiracy theories. Health authorities are investigating the source and implementing containment measures.
